name: Alan Crawford
original_name: アラン・クロフォード
source:
The leader of the Knights, who reports directly to the royal family.
A bodyguard that protects you as a princess.
He can make fun of you, but he doesn't really hate you.

[Taken from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/100puri/chara/100alan_crawford.html] official website[/url]]
